core_obligations: Write Z = Proj(A/I) and pass to a finite affine open cover of S (proof lines 8110-8117).
Choose finitely many f_{i,j} covering each p^{-1}(U_i) (proof lines 8117-8120).
Use finite presentation to generate each local ideal by finitely many h_{i,j,k} (proof lines 8120-8129).
Pick the common degree d and the finite type F inside I_d, and verify it works (proof lines 8129-8137).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated S, a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra A with p : X = Proj_S(A) -> S quasi-compact, and a closed subscheme i : Z -> X of finite presentation, there exist d > 0 and a quasi-coherent finite type submodule F of A_d with Z = Proj_S(A/FA) (source lines 8098-8108). The proof first writes Z as Proj(A/I) for a quasi-coherent graded ideal, then works over a finite affine open cover of S with finitely many homogeneous elements f_{i,j} covering each Proj(A_i), uses finite presentation of i to generate each local ideal by finitely many h_{i,j,k}, and picks a common degree d so that the sections h_{i,j,k} f_{i,j}^{(d - deg h)/deg f} all lie in one finite type F inside I_d.
